searchText: Btw, JSON-RPC technically can utilize `Content-Type` and `Accept` as well as REST API. But then `JSON` prefix won't be correct anymore 🙂 I couldn't reproduce an off-by-one issue with Teku voting in the local net. Added more logging to the process and restarted my nodes, we'll see if it will happen again before the shut down. Then I could take logs and narrow down analysis surface. do you want me to send some deposits? it happened only when deposits were included last time Oh, i haven't noticed that relation. Please, go ahead with deposits if you can send them Well, the only two non-canonical things that happened is that I had sent deposits, twice, once in an invalid block (those that were invalid cause I was forking eth1) and then again in a valid block so it could be either of these phenomenons, in principle, the first doesn't matter cause you didn't even see the block Look at this vote, please, https://nocturne.rayonism.io/block/24576 It's also off by entire period. But I guess no deposits were sent in the previous period (e.g. after slot 22528). Or am I wrong? That is correct, that looks like an off by one, the last deposits were included in block 17441 but when was your first vote with 310 deposits? because during that period that started in block 20480 you still voted for 270 deposits but in the next period, in block 22530 (third block in the period) I already see 310 from the teku team ohh interesting, it was my time to produce a block but got again that error of bad block `Error: invalid merkle root (remote: 9853b385b67c3eb0f6e57b5bec5b0615b9650c40de207e01b0bfe74d1362211e local: 1f5526533acc4f9f8a0262c9ea956c844a1c04d97fc25374886221f2e9f798ba)` I guess I'm stuck again without producing with prysm will send those deposits with the next teku block Ohh something is pretty much broken here, trying to insert my deposits on any block breaks Catalyst. I do not really know how to debug this. Teku also complains of the same invalid merkle root and now I am missing all my proposals, both with Teku and with Prysm
